properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 10 at 9:00AM EDT until August 10 at 9:45AM EDT by NWS Cleveland OH
properties.description:
SVRCLE

The National Weather Service in Cleveland has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Northern Trumbull County in northeastern Ohio...
Ashtabula County in northeastern Ohio...

* Until 945 AM EDT.

* At 859 AM EDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from 6 miles north of Fairport Harbor to near Chardon to
near Burton, moving east at 55 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and penny size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to trees and power lines.

* Locations impacted include...
Ashtabula, Conneaut, Geneva-On-The-Lake, Cortland, Geneva, North
Kingsville, Kinsman, North Bloomfield, Orwell, Andover, West
Farmington, Bristolville, Mecca, Austinburg, Johnston, Kingsville,
Hartsgrove, Roaming Shores, Pierpont, and Cherry Valley.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued August 10 at 7:55AM EDT until August 10 at 10:00AM EDT by NWS Cleveland OH
properties.description:
SMWCLE

The National Weather Service in Cleveland has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Nearshore and Open waters from Avon Point OH to Geneva-on-the-lake
OH...

* Until 1000 AM EDT.

* At 754 AM EDT, strong thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from 27 nm northeast of Kelleys Island to 8 nm north of
Lorain Harbor to 6 nm southeast of Huron, moving east at 40 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts to 40 knots and small hail.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Small craft could be damaged in briefly higher winds and
suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
Willowick, Fairport Harbor, Geneva-On-The-Lake, and Cleveland.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.

Frequent lightning is occurring with these storms. If caught on the
open water stay below deck if possible, keep away from ungrounded
metal objects.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 10 at 9:05AM EDT until August 10 at 9:45AM EDT by NWS Cleveland OH
properties.description:
At 904 AM EDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from near Macedonia to 7 miles west of Cuyahoga Falls to
near Chippewa Lake, moving east at 45 mph.

HAZARD...Ping pong ball size hail and 60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...People and animals outdoors will be injured. Expect hail
damage to roofs, siding, windows, and vehicles. Expect
damage to trees and power lines.

Locations impacted include...
Akron, Medina, Ravenna, Cuyahoga Falls, Kent, Barberton, Hudson,
Wadsworth, Twinsburg, Tallmadge, Streetsboro, Macedonia, Mogadore,
Garrettsville, Mantua, Stow, Broadview Heights, Aurora, Brecksville,
and Norton.

properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued August 10 at 8:47AM EDT until August 10 at 10:15AM EDT by NWS Cleveland OH
properties.description:
SMWCLE

The National Weather Service in Cleveland has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Nearshore and Open waters from Willowick OH to Ripley NY...

* Until 1015 AM EDT.

* At 847 AM EDT, severe thunderstorms capable of producing
waterspouts were located along a line extending from 31 nm west of
Geneva-On-The-Lake to near Fairport Harbor to near Willowick,
moving east at 60 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts, wind gusts to nearly 50 knots, and small
hail.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Small craft could be damaged in briefly
higher winds and suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
Geneva-On-The-Lake, Ashtabula, Erie, and Conneaut.

properties.description:
SVRCLE

The National Weather Service in Cleveland has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Northern Stark County in northeastern Ohio...
Southeastern Summit County in northeastern Ohio...

* Until 1015 AM EDT.

* At 929 AM EDT, a severe thunderstorm was located over Hartville, or
11 miles southeast of Akron, moving southeast at 45 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Minor damage to vehicles is possible. Expect damage to
trees and power lines.

* Locations impacted include...
Akron, Canton, Green, Alliance, North Canton, Louisville,
Hartville, New Franklin, Canal Fulton, Lakemore, East Canton,
Limaville, Greentown, Portage Lakes, Robertsville, Maximo, and
Uniontown.
